description: This file defines the TaskQueueInterface in the GuzzleHttpomise namespace, outlining methods for managing a task queue such as checking if it's empty, adding tasks, and running them.

classes.name: TaskQueueInterface
classes.description: An interface specifying methods for a task queue, including checking if it's empty, adding tasks, and executing pending tasks.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Check if the task queue is empty.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Add a callable task to the queue for future execution.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Execute all pending tasks in the queue.
